Privacy Policy

How SeoTool.im collects, uses, and stores personal data.

Last updated: September 10, 2026

SeoTool.im Privacy Policy

SeoTool.im ("Company", "we", "us", or "our") is committed to maintaining robust privacy protections for its users. Our Privacy Policy is designed to help you understand how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide to us and to assist you in making informed decisions when using our Service.

For purposes of this Agreement, "Site" refers to the Company's website, which can be accessed at https://seotool.im.
"Service" refers to the Company's hosted SeoTool.im product accessed via the Site.
"You" refers to you, as a user of our Site or our Service.
By accessing our Site or our Service, you accept our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use (found here: Terms and Conditions), and you consent to our collection, storage, use, and disclosure of your Personal Information as described in this Privacy Policy.

If you operate or use a self-hosted deployment of SeoTool.im, the operator of that deployment controls the information processed there. This Privacy Policy applies to information collected by SeoTool.im through the Site and hosted services.

I. Information We Collect

We collect "Non-Personal Information" and "Personal Information." Non-Personal Information includes aggregate or de-identified usage information such as referring/exit pages and URLs, page visits, browser type, operating system, device type, approximate location derived from IP address, and similar analytics information. Personal Information includes information such as your name, email address, password, account and session information, organization information, billing or customer identifiers, and other information that you submit to us through the Site or Service.

1. Information collected via Technology

To use the hosted version of the Service, you provide Personal Information such as your name, email address, password, organization information, and billing identifiers. We also track standard information provided by your browser or application when you view or use the Service (referring URL, pages visited, browser type, device type, operating system, approximate location, timestamp). In the authenticated hosted Service, diagnostic logging and session telemetry may be collected to help us identify bugs and improve usability; sensitive inputs are masked.

The public Site uses privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics. In the hosted version of the Service, we use essential cookies strictly necessary to authenticate users, maintain secure sessions, and protect accounts.

2. Information you provide by registering

To use the hosted version of the Service, you create an account by registering with your name, email address, and password, or through third-party authentication (such as Google OAuth). By registering, subscribing, or providing your information, you authorize us to collect, store, and use your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

3. Children's Privacy

The Site and Service are not directed to anyone under the age of 18. The Site does not knowingly collect or solicit information from anyone under the age of 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us at support@seotool.im.

II. How We Use and Share Information

Personal Information

Except as otherwise stated in this Privacy Policy, we do not sell, trade, rent, or otherwise share your Personal Information with third parties for marketing purposes without your consent. We share Personal Information with service providers performing operations on our behalf (such as payment processors, email delivery providers, and hosting infrastructure). Those vendors use your Personal Information only at our direction and in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We use Personal Information to create and secure accounts, authenticate users, provide technical support, process billing, send transactional emails (account verification, password reset, security notices), and deliver product updates.

We may share Personal Information if required to do so by applicable law, regulation, legal process, or enforceable governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or the public.

Non-Personal Information

We use Non-Personal Information to help us analyze trends, administer the Site, and improve the user experience.

III. How We Protect Information

We implement security measures designed to protect your information from unauthorized access, including encryption in transit (HTTPS / TLS), encrypted token storage, and secure server software. Your account is protected by your password, and we urge you to keep your password secure and to log out after each session.

IV. Your Rights Regarding Personal Information

You have the right at any time to opt out of marketing communications by following the unsubscribe link in promotional emails or by contacting support@seotool.im. You may also update your account information or request account deletion from your account settings.

V. Links to Other Websites

As part of the Service, we may provide links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content employed by external websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of third-party sites before providing personal information.

VI. Changes to Our Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. We will post changes to this page with an updated revision date. Significant changes will be communicated via email or prominent in-app notification.

VII. Contact Us

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or our practices, please contact us by email at support@seotool.im.
